review: Independent behavioral alternative to form-copy and size experiments
baseline: e05_static_cards; E06 copy should be removed before testing another factor

observations.fact: CTA timing does not separate success and abandonment
After matching the same hero click between streams, both outcomes show deep page traversal before CTA
All25 input starts finish;75 CTA abandonments never start. Friction from completing a particular field is not observed.
Hero states from4900RUB, while the7900RUB extended tariff is visually featured with border and scale. This may blur the basic offer; no trace proves price confusion.
CPR image was visually inspected: training mannequin, gloved hands, no gore. Calling it objectively frightening is unsupported.
Course date15August2026 predates environment23October2026. Exact replacement date is unknown; do not invent a new date. This is a real credibility issue but not the chosen isolated test.

clock_alignment.issue: session.started_at is a server timestamp; rrweb timestamps are client wall time; action.at_ms uses a client elapsed clock. Direct subtraction can mislabel post-CTA scroll as pre-CTA.
clock_alignment.method: Match rrweb source2/type2 click on snapshot node with class hero-register to action registration_cta; compare rrweb events relative to this common event.
clock_alignment.result: Scroll y237 occurs before hero click; y7573 occurs after, not before. Deep pre-CTA traversal remains true.

priority_hypothesis.claim: Aligning the pricing visual emphasis with the4900RUB starting offer may make the affordable complete-course option easier to understand before the decision to enter contacts.
priority_hypothesis.confidence: low; pricing hierarchy is verified, price-related intent is not observed in recordings
priority_hypothesis.single_factor: Move featured styling from extended tariff to basic tariff; prices, copy, buttons and form unchanged.
exact_diff_plan: On restored E05 HTML, add featured to first pricing-card and remove featured from second pricing-card.
Keep all3tariffs, their prices/features and every btn-register.
Keep CSS styles unchanged so this is a relocation of existing emphasis.
Update exposure variant and experiment log; do not change form fields/validation/API.
priority_hypothesis.prediction: Input-start/CTA and confirmed orders increase over E05 25%, while input-start-to-success remains high. No need to assert increased reading time or hover as intent.
priority_hypothesis.falsifier: No increase in input starts and confirmed orders; more hover or pricing visibility alone does not validate the hypothesis.
risks: All CTA actions use hero; pricing visual hierarchy may have little effect on a scripted decision.
Not all sessions necessarily read prices; deep scroll does not prove attention.
Featured treatment may create a misleading recommendation if explained as objectively best. Do not add such claims.
priority_hypothesis.rules: Allowed visual appearance/inside-section arrangement; no protected contract changes.

comparison_quality.interpretation: Observed decrease does not establish harm from E06 copy. Intervals overlap; batches are sequential and simulator composition/seed is not controlled. Restore E05 as practical working baseline without claiming E06 proven harmful.
test_plan: One isolated100-visit batch after manual deploy, no mixed versions or QA visits.
Verify exposure variant, count unique input-start and confirmed-conversion sessions, reconcile with simulator/server orders.
If a gain is promising, repeat comparable baseline/treatment batches before causal claims.
Keep primary conversion denominator simulator visits;101tracker page sessions are not100unique humans.

non_recommendations: Do not invent an available course date, refund or payment guarantees.
Do not interpret negative-coordinate simulator clicks or collapsed selection artifacts as frustration.
Do not claim changing an image is supported by emotion observed in rrweb.
